key_impacts: More than one million people displaced.
At least five million people affected across countries.
Hospitals and health centres destroyed or damaged.
Water supplies disrupted/contaminated and sanitation facilities damaged.
evidence_snippets: 26 December 2004 a massive 9.0 earthquake west of northern Sumatra triggered a powerful tsunami.
Death toll exceeded 280,000; more than one million persons were displaced.
Assessments covered Banda Aceh and the otherwise inaccessible west coast of Aceh.

key_impacts: Nias and neighbouring islands off Sumatra were affected.
evidence_snippets: 28 March quake affecting Nias and neighbouring Islands off Sumatra.
Continuing seismic activity in Indonesia with daily aftershocks.
